editorial.blurb: Aba brings the warmth of Mediterranean coastal living to a beautifully lit dining room, where crispy short rib hummus, charred vegetables, and perfectly executed kebabs arrive alongside standout desserts like crème brûlée pie.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive hungry and plan to share plates—the dips and appetizers (especially whipped feta and roasted garlic hummus) are worth a repeat visit, and expect a wait during busy weekends, but the consistently fresh pita makes it worthwhile.
